presentation.name: Review what changed between two Tableau workbook versions
presentation.summary: Compares two versions of a workbook by inventory rather than by text, and separates the differences that can move a number from the ones that cannot.
benefits: Discards the save noise that makes a line diff of a workbook unreadable
Reports result-altering changes separately from cosmetic ones, so review attention goes where it counts
Catches the quiet ones: a context filter, a sort under a table calculation, a parameter default
Keeps a renamed field from being reported as one deletion and one addition
States that a difference is a candidate, and names the comparison that would settle it
